bills.title: National Disability Insurance Scheme Amendment (Integrity and Safeguarding) Bill 2026

name: The majority voted against [amendments](https://parlinfo.aph.gov.au/parlInfo/search/display/display.w3p;query=Id:legislation/billhome/display.w3p;query=Id%3A%22legislation%2Famend%2Fs1478_amend_0729ed86-9628-47dd-b53c-25559b467188%22;rec=0) introduced by the Greens party in respect to the definition of and use of the term NDIS supports, replacing it with the phrase "*reasonable and necessary supports*". This means the amendments were unsuccessful.
